title: Loading Carried for a Renter's Record of Rental Damage Claims
content:
A loading may be carried for a renter's own record of rental damage claims filed on their policies under
the Travel Protection Plans, wherever damage is recharged on the Car Rental Rate Classes. The record looked to is the rental damage
claims filed in the last twenty-four months.

**Where the renter has filed more than 2 rental damage claims on their travel protection policies in the
last twenty-four months and holds a travel protection policy in force**, a loading of 25 per cent is
carried.

**Where the renter has filed at least one rental damage claim on their travel protection policies in the
last twenty-four months**, a loading of 10 per cent is carried.

**Where the renter has filed no such claim in that period**, no loading is carried for their record.

## The two marks of the first case

The first row is reached only where both marks hold: the count of claims must stand above the review
threshold of 2, and a travel protection policy of the renter's own must stand in force at the time of
handling.

| Rental damage claims filed in the last twenty-four months | A travel protection policy in force | Loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| none | either | no loading |
| 1 | either | 10 per cent |
| 2 | either | 10 per cent |
| 3 | no | 10 per cent |
| 3 | yes | 25 per cent |

A count standing exactly at 2 does not pass the threshold of 2, because the first row asks for more than
that figure; such a renter takes the second row. A renter with 3 claims but no policy in force likewise
takes the second row.
